name: Al-Husayn I ibn Ali
role: Founder of the Tunisian Husainid dynasty
contribution: The founder of the Husainid Dynasty, which ruled Tunisia until the abolition of the monarchy in 1957.

checks.lead: Al-Husayn I ibn Ali, also known as Hussein I (Arabic: حسين الأول; born in 1675 – 13 September 1740) was the founder of the Husainid Dynasty, which ruled Tunisia until the abolition of the monarchy in 1957.
